title: File:Metropolitan Transportation Authority, Federal Security Funding, October 2025, Kathy Hochul speaking hands open (Hochul cropped3).jpg
art: Marc A. Hermann / Metropolitan Transportation Authority
desc:
Governor Kathy Hochul, MTA Chair & CEO Janno Lieber, and NYPD Commissioner Jessica Tisch at the MTA Headquarters Situation Room on Thursday, Oct 9, 2025 to discuss a pause in federal funding for transit security initiatives.
MTAPD Chief of Police Thomas Taffe.

(Marc A. Hermann / MTA)
